integrated_multimodal_description:
资产角色：
画面由来自 <Picture 1> 的女主角与来自 <Picture 2> 的白绿双色经典 AE86 轿跑车共同演绎。女主面容精致，右眼下方的泪痣清晰可见，扎发利落，身穿深灰运动背心；AE86 墨绿色机盖与开启的方形黄色跳灯在夜间湿润山道上反射出电影级 Lumen 光追质感。

At 00:00.050, the camera begins inside the cockpit of <Subject 2>, an 85mm close-up capturing <Subject 1> in the driver's seat under the dashboard glow. Her sharp eyes lock onto the road ahead, a subtle confident smirk appearing on her lips as her right hand firmly grips and shifts the manual gear lever with mechanical precision. At 00:03.500, the shot dynamically transitions with heavy mechanical damping to a 50mm low-angle exterior tracking shot alongside <Subject 2>. The illuminated yellow pop-up headlights slice through the mist as the rear tires spin violently, kicking up dense white smoke against the dark asphalt before rocketing into the curved mountain pass. At 00:07.500, the camera cuts back to an 85mm medium close-up of <Subject 1> counter-steering with intense focus, jaw set firmly as her eyes track the apex, speaking with confident vocal energy: 女主 (S1), matching the vocal timbre of <Audio 1>, the spirited athletic young woman, shouting over the engine roar: <d>[Chinese] 今晚的山道，是我的主场！</d> Her lips close firmly, breathing deeply as her eyes stay locked on the exit. At 00:11.500, the camera dynamically sweeps into a 50mm exterior follow tracking shot as <Subject 2> executes a high-speed four-wheel drift along the cliff guardrail, red taillights trailing vibrant light streaks, before snapping straight and accelerating full-throttle into the glowing night horizon.

overall_soundscape: Crisp interior gear shift clicks, roaring high-RPM twin-cam engine revs, aggressive tire screeching against tarmac during high-speed drifts, loud blow-off valve release echoes through mountain valleys.non_diegetic_music: High-energy Eurobeat synthwave electronic music with driving 132 BPM four-on-the-floor bass drums, aggressive synth arpeggios, and sudden rhythmic drum-beat drops perfectly synced with gear shifts and drift entries.
